name: aura_park_funding
description: State 2: park map = rawPark > 0 ? low16(trunc(float32(rawPark x funding))) : rawPark. 100 x 0.8 -> 80, 7 x 0.8 = 5.6 -> 5, -20 and 0 kept; at 0.5: 50 and 3; without a Parks and Recreation department the factor is 1.0 and the pipeline still moves to state 3 (test 19 [choice]; the original crashes). The int16 store is the low 16 bits of the CRT _ftol (6 'Integer stores', [compat]): at funding 1.2 (float32 1.20000005) raw 30000 gives trunc(36000.0) = 36000, stored as -29536 (wrap, not 32767); 100 -> 120.000005 -> 120 and 7 -> 8.4 -> 8. A stub budget whose funding is NaN gives NaN products, and _ftol of NaN is 0x8000000000000000, low 16 bits 0 -> 0 (non-positive raw values are not multiplied). Products are one f32 multiply (foundations 18), values from a Python/numpy float32 model.
